chapter: Tatum, Wiggins and Los Angeles friends
title: Afterglow of the concert and upcoming gigs with McShann and Turetzky
summary: They remember the overflow audience and Callender mentions a coming date with Jay McShann and duo concerts of Ellington music with Bert Turetzky.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: You turned away people at that auditorium. It was marvelous.

Yes, and I would certainly like to do some more of that. I enjoyed doing that. On June 15th, I am playing with Jay McShann at the University of California at San Diego. I've done a couple of concerts down there with Bert Turetzky, who is a bass professor. We did some duos of Duke Ellington music, too, things that he put together called "Down In Duke's Basement."
